--- Code Cell 32 ---
def feature_engineering(df):
    df = df.copy()
    
    # 1. Cast categories first
    cat_cols = ['Gender', 'Customer Type', 'Type of Travel', 'Class']
    for col in cat_cols:
        df[col] = df[col].astype('category')
        
    # 2. Service Columns List
    service_cols = ['Inflight wifi service','Departure/Arrival time convenient',
     'Ease of Online booking','Gate location','Food and drink','Online boarding',
     'Seat comfort','Inflight entertainment','On-board service','Leg room service',
     'Baggage handling','Checkin service','Cleanliness']
    
    # 3. Keep the top-performing engineered features
    df['weighted_top3'] = (df['Online boarding'] * 0.56 +
                           df['Inflight entertainment'] * 0.43 +
                           df['Seat comfort'] * 0.40) / (0.56 + 0.43 + 0.40)
    
    df['mean_top_services'] = df[['Online boarding', 'Inflight entertainment', 'Seat comfort']].mean(axis=1)
    
    df['Class_Type'] = df['Class'].astype(str) + '_' + df['Type of Travel'].astype(str)
    
    # 4. Rating counts
    df['num_zero_ratings'] = (df[service_cols] == 0).sum(axis=1)
    df['num_high_ratings'] = (df[service_cols] >= 4).sum(axis=1)
    
    # 5. Max rating
    df['service_max'] = df[service_cols].max(axis=1)
    
    # 6. Continuous Transformation & Interaction
    df['log_flight_distance'] = np.log1p(df['Flight Distance'])
    df['age_x_class'] = (df['Age'] * (df['Class'].cat.codes + 1)).astype('int16')
    
    # 7. Finalize categorical columns
    cat_cols_final = ['Gender', 'Customer Type', 'Type of Travel', 'Class', 'Class_Type']
    for col in cat_cols_final:
        df[col] = df[col].astype('category')
        
    df = df.drop(columns=['id'], errors='ignore')
    
    return df

# Apply and rebuild X, y, X_test
train_fe = feature_engineering(train)
test_fe = feature_engineering(test)

# 1. Define target variable
y = train_fe['satisfaction'].astype(int)

# We drop 'satisfaction' and 'target' (the temporary column from correlation)

X_test = test_fe.copy()

# 3. Verify alignment

--- Code Cell 34 ---
print("Computing Route Geometry...")
# Use raw train and test to avoid any leakage
combined = pd.concat([
    train.drop(columns=['satisfaction', 'id'], errors='ignore'),
    test.drop(columns=['id'], errors='ignore')
], ignore_index=True)

service_cols = ['Inflight wifi service','Departure/Arrival time convenient',
 'Ease of Online booking','Gate location','Food and drink','Online boarding',
 'Seat comfort','Inflight entertainment','On-board service','Leg room service',
 'Baggage handling','Checkin service','Cleanliness']

g = combined.groupby('Flight Distance')
agg = g[service_cols + ['Age']].mean().add_prefix('fd_mean_')
agg['fd_count'] = g.size().astype(np.int32)

if 'Class' in combined.columns:
    is_business = (combined['Class'] == 'Business').astype(int)
    agg['fd_share_Business'] = is_business.groupby(combined['Flight Distance']).mean()

# --- 3. Join Route Geometry to X and X_test ---
X = X.join(agg, on='Flight Distance', rsuffix='_route')
X_test = X_test.join(agg, on='Flight Distance', rsuffix='_route')

# --- 4. Final Verification ---
print(f"✅ Route Geometry added!")
print(f"X shape:      {X.shape}")
print(f"X_test shape: {X_test.shape}")
print(f"Columns match: {X.columns.equals(X_test.columns)}")
--- Code Cell 37 ---
# 1. Setup Cross-Validation
n_splits = 5
skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=n_splits, shuffle=True, random_state=42)

# Arrays to store predictions
lgb_oof_preds = np.zeros(len(X))
lgb_test_preds = np.zeros(len(X_test))

# LightGBM parameters (Baseline)
# Best parameters from RandomizedSearchCV
lgb_params =  {
    'objective': 'binary',
    'metric': 'auc',
    'boosting_type': 'gbdt',
    'learning_rate': 0.043013213230530575,
    'num_leaves': 39,
    'max_depth': 10,
    'min_data_in_leaf': 148,
    'feature_fraction': 0.7113068222276344,
    'bagging_fraction': 0.8356740207895621,
    'bagging_freq': 1,
    'lambda_l1': 0.011756010900231853,
    'lambda_l2': 0.05731044951044767,
    'max_bin': 255,
    'num_threads': -1,
    'seed': 42,
    'verbosity': -1
}
# Also increase num_boost_round to 3000-5000 since lr is lower


# 2. Training Loop
print(f"Starting {n_splits}-Fold Cross-Validation...\n")

for fold, (train_idx, val_idx) in enumerate(skf.split(X, y)):
    # Split data
    X_train, y_train = X.iloc[train_idx], y.iloc[train_idx]
    X_val, y_val = X.iloc[val_idx], y.iloc[val_idx]
    
    # Create LightGBM datasets
    dtrain = lgb.Dataset(X_train, label=y_train)
    dval = lgb.Dataset(X_val, label=y_val, reference=dtrain)
    
    # Train model with early stopping
    lgb_model = lgb.train(
        lgb_params,
        dtrain,
        num_boost_round=4000,
        valid_sets=[dtrain, dval],
        callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=100), lgb.log_evaluation(period=200)]
    )
    
    # Predict OOF and Test
    lgb_oof_preds[val_idx] = lgb_model.predict(X_val, num_iteration=lgb_model.best_iteration)
    lgb_test_preds += lgb_model.predict(X_test, num_iteration=lgb_model.best_iteration) / n_splits
    
    # Print fold score
    fold_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, lgb_oof_preds[val_idx])
    print(f"Fold {fold+1} AUC: {fold_auc:.5f}")

# 3. Overall CV Score
overall_auc = roc_auc_score(y, lgb_oof_preds)
print(f"\n=========================================")
print(f"Overall OOF AUC: {overall_auc:.5f}")
print(f"=========================================")

# 4. Create Submission File
# Note: We use the original test dataframe's 'id' because we dropped it in the FE step
submission = pd.DataFrame({
    'id': test['id'],
    'satisfaction': lgb_test_preds
})

print("\nSubmission saved to 'submission_baseline.csv'")
print(submission.head())

# Prepare data for XGBoost (supports native category)
# We use the clean X and X_test from the latest feature engineering step
xgb_oof_preds = np.zeros(len(X))
xgb_test_preds = np.zeros(len(X_test))

xgb_params = {
    'objective': 'binary:logistic',
    'eval_metric': 'auc',
    'tree_method': 'hist',
    'enable_categorical': True,  # Enable native categorical handling
    'learning_rate': 0.05,
    'max_depth': 7,
    'min_child_weight': 5,
    'subsample': 0.8,
    'colsample_bytree': 0.8,
    'n_jobs': -1,
    'random_state': 42,
}

xgb_params_v2 = {
    'n_estimators': 1200,
    'learning_rate': 0.04,
    'max_depth': 8,
    'max_bin': 4096,
    'subsample': 0.80,
    'colsample_bytree': 0.20,
    'objective': 'binary:logistic',
    'eval_metric': 'auc',
    'tree_method': 'hist',
    'random_state': 42,
    'enable_categorical': True, # Enable native categorical handling for pandas 'category' dtype columns
    'n_jobs': -1,
}

skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42)

print("Starting XGBoost 5-Fold CV...\n")
for fold, (train_idx, val_idx) in enumerate(skf.split(X, y)):
    dtrain = xgb.DMatrix(X.iloc[train_idx], label=y.iloc[train_idx], enable_categorical=True)
    dval   = xgb.DMatrix(X.iloc[val_idx], label=y.iloc[val_idx], enable_categorical=True)
    dtest  = xgb.DMatrix(X_test, enable_categorical=True)
    
    xgb_model = xgb.train(
        xgb_params_v2,
        dtrain,
        num_boost_round=2000,
        evals=[(dval, 'val')],
        early_stopping_rounds=100,
        verbose_eval=200
    )
    
    #Predict OOF and Test
    xgb_oof_preds[val_idx] = xgb_model.predict(dval, iteration_range=(0, xgb_model.best_iteration + 1))
    xgb_test_preds   += xgb_model.predict(dtest, iteration_range=(0, xgb_model.best_iteration + 1)) / 5
    print(f"Fold {fold+1} AUC: {roc_auc_score(y.iloc[val_idx], xgb_oof_preds[val_idx]):.5f}\n")


print(f"=========================================")
print(f"XGBoost Overall OOF AUC: {roc_auc_score(y, xgb_oof_preds):.5f}")
print(f"=========================================")

# ---- 3. CatBoost ----
# CatBoost needs string for categorical features
cat_features = ['Gender', 'Customer Type', 'Type of Travel', 'Class', 'Class_Type']
X_cb = X.copy()
X_test_cb = X_test.copy()

for col in cat_features:
    X_cb[col] = X_cb[col].astype(str)
    X_test_cb[col] = X_test_cb[col].astype(str)

cb_oof_preds = np.zeros(len(X_cb))
cb_test_preds = np.zeros(len(X_test_cb))

skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42)

print("Starting CatBoost 5-Fold CV...\n")
for fold, (train_idx, val_idx) in enumerate(skf.split(X_cb, y)):
    cb_model = CatBoostClassifier(
        iterations=3000,
        task_type='GPU',
        learning_rate=0.05,
        depth=6,
        l2_leaf_reg=3.0,
        eval_metric='AUC',
        cat_features=cat_features,
        early_stopping_rounds=150,
        verbose=200,
        random_seed=42,
        thread_count=-1,
    )
    
    cb_model.fit(X_cb.iloc[train_idx], y.iloc[train_idx], eval_set=(X_cb.iloc[val_idx], y.iloc[val_idx]), use_best_model=True)
    
    cb_oof_preds[val_idx] = cb_model.predict_proba(X_cb.iloc[val_idx])[:, 1]
    cb_test_preds += cb_model.predict_proba(X_test_cb)[:, 1] / 5
    
    print(f"Fold {fold+1} AUC: {roc_auc_score(y.iloc[val_idx], cb_oof_preds[val_idx]):.5f}\n")

print(f"=========================================")
print(f"CatBoost Overall OOF AUC: {roc_auc_score(y, cb_oof_preds):.5f}")
print(f"=========================================")
--- Code Cell 47 ---
print("=" * 60)
print("FINAL ROBUST BLEND & SUBMISSION")
print("=" * 60)

# 1. Collect the exact variables you already have in memory
models = {
    'LGBM': lgb_oof_preds,
    'XGB_HighBin': xgb_oof_preds,
    'CatBoost': cb_oof_preds
}
models_test = {
    'LGBM': lgb_test_preds,
    'XGB_HighBin': xgb_test_preds,
    'CatBoost': cb_test_preds
}

for name in models:
    print(f"✅ {name} OOF AUC: {roc_auc_score(y, models[name]):.5f}")

# 2. Rank Average Blend
oof_ranks = np.array([rankdata(p) / len(y) for p in models.values()])
test_ranks = np.array([rankdata(p) / len(X_test) for p in models_test.values()])

blend_oof_rank = oof_ranks.mean(axis=0)
blend_test_rank = test_ranks.mean(axis=0)
auc_rank = roc_auc_score(y, blend_oof_rank)

# 3. Weighted Blend (Grid Search)
weight_grid = [w for w in product(np.arange(0.1, 0.85, 0.05), repeat=3) if abs(sum(w) - 1.0) < 0.001]
best_auc = 0
best_weights = None

for w in weight_grid:
    blended = sum(wi * oof_ranks[i] for i, wi in enumerate(w))
    auc = roc_auc_score(y, blended)
    if auc > best_auc:
        best_auc = auc
        best_weights = w

print("-" * 45)
print(f"Rank Average OOF:   {auc_rank:.5f}")
print(f"Weighted Blend OOF: {best_auc:.5f}")
print(f"Best Weights: LGB={best_weights[0]:.2f}, XGB={best_weights[1]:.2f}, CB={best_weights[2]:.2f}")

# 4. Create BOTH submissions so you can test
# A: Rank Average Submission
final_rank = (blend_test_rank - blend_test_rank.min()) / (blend_test_rank.max() - blend_test_rank.min())
sub_rank = pd.DataFrame({'id': test['id'], 'satisfaction': final_rank})
sub_rank.to_csv('submission_rank_average.csv', index=False)
print("\n✅ Saved: submission_rank_average.csv")

# B: Weighted Blend Submission
blend_test_weighted = sum(wi * test_ranks[i] for i, wi in enumerate(best_weights))
final_weighted = (blend_test_weighted - blend_test_weighted.min()) / (blend_test_weighted.max() - blend_test_weighted.min())
sub_weighted = pd.DataFrame({'id': test['id'], 'satisfaction': final_weighted})
sub_weighted.to_csv('submission_weighted_blend.csv', index=False)
print("✅ Saved: submission_weighted_blend.csv")

import os, sys, gc, time, glob, random, json, warnings
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')
SEED = 42
random.seed(SEED); np.random.seed(SEED)
SMOKE = os.environ.get('S6E10_SMOKE', '0') == '1'
FOLDS = 2 if SMOKE else 5
N_ENS = 1 if SMOKE else 4
N_EPOCHS = 1 if SMOKE else 4
ROOTS = os.environ.get('INPUT_ROOTS', '/kaggle/input').split(':')

def find_file(name, must=True):
    for root in ROOTS:
        hits = sorted(glob.glob(f'{root}/**/{name}', recursive=True))
        if hits:
            return hits[0]
    if must:
        raise FileNotFoundError(name)
    return None

print('SMOKE =', SMOKE, '| FOLDS', FOLDS, '| N_ENS', N_ENS, '| N_EPOCHS', N_EPOCHS)
try:
    import pytabkit
    from importlib.metadata import version
    print('pytabkit', version('pytabkit'))
except ImportError:
    print('installing pytabkit ...')
    ok = os.system('pip install -q pytabkit')
    if ok != 0:
        whl = find_file('pytabkit*.whl')
        print('internet install failed, falling back to wheelhouse:', whl)
        os.system(f'pip install -q --no-index --find-links={os.path.dirname(whl)} pytabkit')
    from pytabkit import RealMLP_TD_Classifier
else:
    from pytabkit import RealMLP_TD_Classifier
import torch

          "Inflight entertainment", "On-board service", "Leg room service", "Baggage handling",

# ---- original rows (append arm) ----

orig = orig.rename(columns={c: c for c in orig.columns})
if SMOKE:
    orig = orig.iloc[:8000].copy()
print('orig', orig.shape, '| cols', list(orig.columns)[:8], '...')

# ---- lookup tables (21 empirical-rate columns, +0.000927 measured) ----
D_ALIGN = os.path.dirname(find_file('lookup_long.csv'))
sys.path.append(D_ALIGN)
L = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(D_ALIGN, 'lookup_long.csv'), dtype={'value': str}, keep_default_na=False)

def add_lookup(df):
    # unseen levels on comp data -> fill with the feature's empirical rate mean
    for f, t in L[L.feature.isin(df.columns)].groupby('feature'):
        col = df[f].astype(str).fillna('nan').map(dict(zip(t.value, t.rate)))
        n_na = int(col.isna().sum())
        if n_na:
            print(f'  lookup {f}: {n_na} unseen levels -> feature rate mean')
            col = col.fillna(float(t['rate'].mean()))
        df['orig_rate__' + f] = col.astype(np.float32)
    # the combination key (Type of Travel|Class|Customer Type), from USAGE.md
    if 'Type of Travel' in df.columns and not any(c.startswith('orig_rate__Type of Travel|') for c in df.columns):
        key = df['Type of Travel'].astype(str) + '|' + df['Class'].astype(str) + '|' + df['Customer Type'].astype(str)
        row = L[L.feature == 'Type of Travel|Class|Customer Type']
        if len(row):
            col = key.map(dict(zip(row.value, row.rate)))
            n_na = int(col.isna().sum())
            if n_na:
                print(f'  lookup combo: {n_na} unseen levels -> rate mean')
                col = col.fillna(float(row['rate'].mean()))
            df['orig_rate__tot_cls_cust'] = col.astype(np.float32)
    return df

# ---- original-model teacher logits (+0.000287 measured) ----
from original_model import score as score_original

# ---- route geometry on train+test+orig (target-free) ----
allf = pd.concat([train.drop(columns=['id', TARGET], errors='ignore'),
                  test.drop(columns=['id'], errors='ignore'),
                  orig.drop(columns=['id', TARGET], errors='ignore')], ignore_index=True)
g = allf.groupby(FD)
agg = g[SURVEY + ['Age']].mean().add_prefix('fd_mean_').astype(np.float32)
agg['fd_count'] = g.size().astype(np.int32)
top_class = allf['Class'].mode()[0]
agg['fd_share_biz'] = (allf['Class'] == top_class).groupby(allf[FD]).mean().astype(np.float32)
del allf; gc.collect()

def build(df, has_target):
    df = add_lookup(df)
    ogp = score_original(df)
    df['ogp_xgb_d8'] = ogp['ogp_xgb_d8'].values.astype(np.float32)
    df['ogp_lgb'] = ogp['ogp_lgb'].values.astype(np.float32)
    df = df.join(agg, on=FD)
    for c in ['Arrival Delay in Minutes', 'Departure Delay in Minutes']:
        df[c] = df[c].fillna(0.0)
    df['log_dep_delay'] = np.log1p(np.maximum(df['Departure Delay in Minutes'], 0)).astype(np.float32)
    df['log_arr_delay'] = np.log1p(np.maximum(df['Arrival Delay in Minutes'], 0)).astype(np.float32)
    df['delay_diff'] = (df['Arrival Delay in Minutes'] - df['Departure Delay in Minutes']).astype(np.float32)
    df['has_no_delay'] = ((df['Departure Delay in Minutes'] == 0) & (df['Arrival Delay in Minutes'] == 0)).astype(np.int32)
    for c in SURVEY:
        df[f'{c}_is_zero'] = (df[c] == 0).astype(np.int32)
    df['wifi0_booking0'] = ((df['Inflight wifi service'] == 0) & (df['Ease of Online booking'] == 0)).astype(np.int32)
    df['total_survey'] = df[SURVEY].sum(axis=1).astype(np.float32)
    df['zero_survey_count'] = (df[SURVEY] == 0).sum(axis=1).astype(np.int32)
    df['fd_len'] = df[FD].astype(str).str.len().astype(np.int32)
    df['fd_mod100'] = (df[FD] % 100).astype(np.int32)
    df['age_mod10'] = (df['Age'] % 10).astype(np.int32)
    for c in CATS:
        df[c] = df[c].astype('category').cat.codes.astype(np.int32)
    drop = ['id'] + ([TARGET] if has_target else [])
    return df

tr_df = build(train, True);  y = train[TARGET].astype(np.int8).values
te_df = build(test, False)
og_df = build(orig, True);   y_og = orig[TARGET].astype(np.int8).values

DROP = {'id', TARGET}
FEATS = [c for c in tr_df.columns if c not in DROP]
X = tr_df[FEATS].astype(np.float32); Xt = te_df[FEATS].astype(np.float32); Xo = og_df[FEATS].astype(np.float32)
for name, M in [('train', X), ('test', Xt), ('orig', Xo)]:
    n_nan = int(M.isna().sum().sum())
    if n_nan:
        bad = M.isna().sum(); print(f'  {name}: {n_nan} NaNs in', bad[bad > 0].index.tolist()[:8], '-> fill 0')
        M.fillna(0.0, inplace=True)
print(f'FE done in {time.time()-t0:.1f}s | features: {len(FEATS)}')
print(FEATS)

from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score

skf = StratifiedKFold(n_splits=FOLDS, shuffle=True, random_state=SEED)

params = dict(
    random_state=42, verbosity=1, val_metric_name='1-auc_ovr',
    n_ens=N_ENS, n_epochs=N_EPOCHS, batch_size=288,
    use_early_stopping=False,
    lr=0.053, wd=0.015, sq_mom=0.988,
    lr_sched='flat_anneal', wd_sched='cos_log_15',
    first_layer_lr_factor=0.25,
    embedding_size=5, max_one_hot_cat_size=2,
    hidden_sizes=[512, 256, 128], act='silu',
    p_drop=0.05, p_drop_sched='pow5',
    plr_hidden_1=16, plr_hidden_2=8, plr_act_name='gelu',
    plr_lr_factor=0.1151, plr_sigma=0.75,
    ls_eps=0.01, ls_eps_sched='sqrt_cos',
    add_front_scale=False, bias_init_mode='neg-uniform-dynamic-2',
    tfms=['one_hot', 'median_center', 'robust_scale', 'smooth_clip', 'embedding', 'l2_normalize'],
)

oof_rider = np.zeros(len(X), dtype=np.float64)
test_rider = np.zeros(len(Xt), dtype=np.float64)
fold_aucs = []
t_ride = time.time()

for fold, (a, b) in enumerate(skf.split(X, y)):
    tf0 = time.time()
    # row-append arm: fold-train + original rows (USAGE.md: +0.001029 w/ lookups vs +0.000927)
    X_tr = pd.concat([X.iloc[a], Xo], ignore_index=True)
    y_tr = np.concatenate([y[a], y_og])
    X_va = X.iloc[b]
    model = RealMLP_TD_Classifier(**params)
    model.fit(X_tr, y_tr, X_va, y[b])
    oof_rider[b] = model.predict_proba(X_va)[:, 1]
    test_rider += model.predict_proba(Xt)[:, 1] / FOLDS
    auc_f = roc_auc_score(y[b], oof_rider[b])
    fold_aucs.append(float(auc_f))
    print(f'fold {fold+1}/{FOLDS} AUC {auc_f:.6f} ({time.time()-tf0:.0f}s)')
    torch.cuda.empty_cache() if torch.cuda.is_available() else None
    gc.collect()

oof_auc = roc_auc_score(y, oof_rider)
print(f'==> RIDER OOF AUC: {oof_auc:.6f} | total {time.time()-t_ride:.0f}s')
np.save('oof_rider_synthview.npy', oof_rider)
np.save('test_rider_synthview.npy', test_rider)
with open('rider_ledger.json', 'w') as f:
    json.dump({'oof_auc': float(oof_auc), 'fold_aucs': fold_aucs,
               'folds': FOLDS, 'n_ens': N_ENS, 'n_epochs': N_EPOCHS,
               'features': FEATS, 'params': {k: str(v) for k, v in params.items()}}, f, indent=2)

def pr(x):
    return (pd.Series(x).rank().values - 0.5) / len(x)

def to_logit(p):
    p = np.clip(p, 1e-6, 1 - 1e-6)
    return np.log(p / (1 - p))

# ---- anchor: gpjw Probe G (public LB 0.96216) ----
probeG = pd.read_csv(find_file('meta_part6_probeG_096216_1028.csv'))
if len(probeG) != len(test):
    print(f'SMOKE: truncating probeG {len(probeG)} -> {len(test)}')
    probeG = probeG.iloc[:len(test)].copy()
assert (probeG['id'].values == test['id'].values).all()
z_anchor = to_logit(pr(probeG['satisfaction'].values))
z_rider = to_logit(pr(test_rider))

ids = test['id'].values
grid = [0.02, 0.04, 0.06, 0.08, 0.12] if not SMOKE else [0.5]
for w in grid:
    z = (1 - w) * z_anchor + w * z_rider
    out = pd.DataFrame({'id': ids, 'satisfaction': pr(z)})
    out.to_csv(f'submission_rider_w{w:.2f}.csv', index=False)
    print(f'wrote submission_rider_w{w:.2f}.csv')

# PRIMARY auto-submit: w=0.06 (mirrors V15's 6% new-info architecture)
w = 0.06
z = (1 - w) * z_anchor + w * z_rider
sub = pd.DataFrame({'id': ids, 'satisfaction': pr(z)})
assert len(sub) == len(test) and sub['satisfaction'].notna().all()
assert (sub['id'] == ids).all()
sub.to_csv('submission.csv', index=False)
print('PRIMARY submission.csv written (anchor 0.94 + rider 0.06)')

# rider-only reference file
pd.DataFrame({'id': ids, 'satisfaction': pr(test_rider)}).to_csv('submission_rider_only.csv', index=False)
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
print('Spearman(rider, probeG) =', spearmanr(pr(test_rider), pr(probeG['satisfaction'].values)).statistic)
print('rider test mean/std:', test_rider.mean(), test_rider.std())

import glob, os, json, re
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from scipy.stats import rankdata

INP = '/kaggle/input' if os.path.isdir('/kaggle/input') else os.environ.get('BLEND_INPUT', './input')
OUT = '/kaggle/working' if os.path.isdir('/kaggle/working') else './working'
os.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True)

comp = [d for d in glob.glob(INP + '/**/playground-series-s6e10', recursive=True) if os.path.isdir(d)][0]
te = pd.read_csv(comp + '/test.csv', usecols=['id'])
IDS = te['id'].values
N = len(IDS)

def short(path):
    p = path[len(INP):].strip('/').split('/')
    keep = [x for x in p if x not in ('notebooks', 'datasets', 'competitions', 'kaggle', 'working', 'input')]
    return '/'.join(keep[-3:])

C = {}
# 1) every submission-format csv: id + one numeric column, all test ids
for f in sorted(glob.glob(INP + '/**/*.csv', recursive=True)):
    if '/playground-series-s6e10/' in f or 'oof' in os.path.basename(f).lower():
        continue
    try:
        head = pd.read_csv(f, nrows=3)
    except Exception:
        continue
    if 'id' not in head.columns or head.shape[1] != 2:
        continue
    try:
        df = pd.read_csv(f)
        col = [c for c in df.columns if c != 'id'][0]
        if len(df) != N or not pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(df[col]):
            continue
        v = df.set_index('id')[col].reindex(IDS).values.astype(float)
        if np.isnan(v).any():
            continue
        C['csv:' + short(f)] = v
    except Exception as e:
        print('skip', f, e)
# 2) cdeotte TFM test arrays (row order = test.csv)
for f in sorted(glob.glob(INP + '/**/test_*.npy', recursive=True)):
    v = np.load(f).astype(float).ravel()
    if len(v) == N and np.isfinite(v).all():
        C['npy:' + os.path.basename(f)[5:-4]] = v
# 3) my own model test predictions (aligned by saved ids)
for f in sorted(glob.glob(INP + '/**/s6e10_out/models/*/test.npy', recursive=True)):
    root = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(f)))
    ids = np.load(root + '/ids_test.npy', allow_pickle=True)
    v = pd.Series(np.load(f).astype(float), index=ids).reindex(IDS).values
    if not np.isnan(v).any():
        C['own:' + f.split('/')[-2]] = v

R = {k: rankdata(v) / N for k, v in C.items()}
names = list(C)
print(len(names), 'candidate vectors')

def logit(p):
    p = np.clip(p, 1e-6, 1 - 1e-6)
    return np.log(p / (1 - p))

def is_prob(v):
    return v.min() >= 0 and v.max() <= 1

# de-duplicate near-identical vectors (keep first)
uniq = []
for k in names:
    if all(np.corrcoef(R[k], R[u])[0, 1] < 0.999999 for u in uniq):
        uniq.append(k)
print(len(uniq), 'distinct after dedupe')

def find(pattern, pool=None):
    pool = pool or uniq
    hits = [k for k in pool if re.search(pattern, k, re.I)]
    return hits[0] if hits else None

pd.set_option('display.width', 200, 'display.max_colwidth', 80, 'display.max_rows', 200)

def blend(parts, space='logit'):
    tot = sum(w for _, w in parts)
    if space == 'rank':
        z = sum(w * R[k] for k, w in parts) / tot
        return z
    z = sum(w * logit(C[k] if is_prob(C[k]) else R[k]) for k, w in parts) / tot
    return 1 / (1 + np.exp(-z))

--- Code Cell 3 ---
import os
import glob
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from cuml.linear_model import LogisticRegression

COMP = "/kaggle/input/competitions/playground-series-s6e10"
PRED_DIRS = [
    "/kaggle/input/datasets/cdeotte/s6e10-124-public-oof-and-test-predictions",
    "/kaggle/input/datasets/cdeotte/s6e10-tfm-oof-and-test-predictions",
]
OUT = "/kaggle/working"
TARGET = "satisfaction"
TOP_N = 20  # number of models to list by |logistic regression coefficient|
C = 1.0     # inverse L2 regularization strength of the stacker
--- Code Cell 5 ---
train = pd.read_csv(f"{COMP}/train.csv", usecols=["id", TARGET])
test = pd.read_csv(f"{COMP}/test.csv", usecols=["id"])
y = train[TARGET].astype(int).to_numpy()

folds = np.zeros(len(y), dtype=int)
for k, (_, valid_idx) in enumerate(StratifiedKFold(5, shuffle=True, random_state=42).split(np.zeros(len(y)), y)):
    folds[valid_idx] = k
print(f"Train {len(train):,} rows | Test {len(test):,} rows | positive rate {y.mean():.4f}")
--- Code Cell 7 ---
def to_logit(p):
    p = np.clip(p.astype(np.float64), 1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)
    return np.log(p / (1 - p))

names, X_oof, X_test, rows = [], [], [], []
for d in PRED_DIRS:
    for f in sorted(glob.glob(f"{d}/oof_*.npy")):
        name = os.path.basename(f)[len("oof_"):-len(".npy")]
        oof, tst = np.load(f), np.load(f"{d}/test_{name}.npy")
        assert oof.shape == (len(train),) and tst.shape == (len(test),), name
        assert np.isfinite(oof).all() and np.isfinite(tst).all(), name
        already_logit = bool(oof.min() < 0 or oof.max() > 1 or tst.min() < 0 or tst.max() > 1)
        if not already_logit:
            oof, tst = to_logit(oof), to_logit(tst)
        names.append(name)
        X_oof.append(np.clip(oof, -30, 30).astype(np.float32))
        X_test.append(np.clip(tst, -30, 30).astype(np.float32))
        rows.append(dict(model=name, dataset=os.path.basename(d), already_logit=already_logit,
                         oof_auc=roc_auc_score(y, X_oof[-1])))

assert len(set(names)) == len(names), "duplicate model names"
X_oof, X_test = np.stack(X_oof, axis=1), np.stack(X_test, axis=1)
models = pd.DataFrame(rows)
print(f"Loaded {len(names)} OOF/test pairs: X_oof {X_oof.shape}, X_test {X_test.shape}")
print(models["dataset"].value_counts().to_string())
print("\nAlready logits (used as is, not converted):")
print(models[models["already_logit"]].to_string(index=False))
print("\nBest single models by OOF AUC:")
models.sort_values("oof_auc", ascending=False).head(10).reset_index(drop=True)
--- Code Cell 9 ---
oof_stack = np.zeros(len(y))
test_stack = np.zeros(len(test))
coefs = []
for k in range(5):
    tr, va = folds != k, folds == k
    lr = LogisticRegression(penalty="l2", C=C, fit_intercept=True, solver="qn", max_iter=2000, tol=1e-7,
                            output_type="numpy", verbose=False)
    lr.fit(X_oof[tr], y[tr])
    oof_stack[va] = lr.predict_proba(X_oof[va])[:, 1]
    test_stack += lr.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1] / 5
    coefs.append(np.ravel(lr.coef_))
    print(f"Fold {k} AUC: {roc_auc_score(y[va], oof_stack[va]):.6f}")

print(f"\nStack CV AUC: {roc_auc_score(y, oof_stack):.6f} ({len(names)} models)")
--- Code Cell 11 ---
coef = np.mean(coefs, axis=0)
importance = models.assign(coefficient=coef, abs_coefficient=np.abs(coef))
importance = importance.sort_values("abs_coefficient", ascending=False).reset_index(drop=True)
print(f"Top {TOP_N} of {len(names)} models by |coefficient|:")
importance.head(TOP_N)
--- Code Cell 13 ---
np.save(f"{OUT}/stack_oof.npy", oof_stack)
np.save(f"{OUT}/stack_test.npy", test_stack)

submission = pd.read_csv(f"{COMP}/sample_submission.csv")
assert np.array_equal(submission["id"].to_numpy(), test["id"].to_numpy())
submission[TARGET] = test_stack
submission.to_csv(f"{OUT}/submission.csv", index=False)
submission.head()

the interval and sampled pairs are separate statistics."""\n    out = Path(out)\n    a, b = report.candidate.tolist()\n    if \'delta_b_minus_a\' not in comparison:\n        return []\n    d = comparison[\'delta_b_minus_a\']\n    lo, hi = comparison[\'conditional_low95\'], comparison[\'conditional_high95\']\n    def label(name):\n        return name if len(name) <= 28 else name[:17]+\'...\'+name[-7:]\n    labels = \'A: \'+label(a)+\' | B: \'+label(b)\n    heading = (recorded_label+\'\\n\' if recorded_label else \'\')+fill(labels, 48)\n    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(3.5, 2.65), layout=\'constrained\')\n    fig.suptitle(heading, fontsize=9)\n    ax.axvline(0, color=\'#888888\', lw=1)\n    ax.errorbar(\n        [d * 1e4], [0],\n        xerr=[[max(0, d-lo) * 1e4], [max(0, hi-d) * 1e4]],\n        fmt=\'o\', color=\'#0072B2\', capsize=4,\n    )\n    ax.set_yticks([0], [\'B minus A\'])\n    ax.set_ylim(-.8, .8)\n    ax.set_xlabel(\'AUC difference / 0.0001\', fontsize=9)\n    ax.set_title(\'Conditional 95% OOF interval\', loc=\'left\', fontsize=10)\n    span = max(hi-lo, abs(d)*.2, 1e-6)\n    ax.set_xlim(min(lo-span*.25, 0-span*.15)*1e4,\n                max(hi+span*.25, 0+span*.15)*1e4)\n    path = out/f\'{prefix}_auc_interval.png\'\n    fig.savefig(path)\n    plt.close(fig)\n    panels = [image_html(\n        path,\n        f\'{recorded_label or "Current comparison"}. A is {a}; B is {b}. \'\n        f\'OOF AUC difference B minus A is {auc_text(d, True)}; \'\n        f\'the conditional 95% interval is [{auc_text(lo, True)}, {auc_text(hi, True)}].\',\n    )]\n\n    pairs = comparison[\'ranking_pairs\']\n    values = [pairs[\'a_wrong_b_correct_pct\'],\n              pairs[\'b_wrong_a_correct_pct\'], pairs[\'both_strictly_wrong_pct\']]\n    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(3.5, 2.65), layout=\'constrained\')\n    fig.suptitle(heading, fontsize=9)\n    ax.barh([\'A wrong, B correct\', \'B wrong, A correct\', \'Both strictly wrong\'],\n            values, color=[\'#0072B2\', \'#D55E00\', \'#777777\'], height=.55)\n    ax.invert_yaxis()\n    ax.set_xlabel(\'Sampled ranking pairs (%)\', fontsize=9)\n    ax.set_xlim(0, max(values)*1.35+.1)\n    ax.set_title(\'Shared ranking errors\', loc=\'left\', fontsize=10)\n    for i, value in enumerate(values):\n        ax.text(value+.04, i, f\'{value:.2f}%\', va=\'center\', fontsize=9)\n    path = out/f\'{prefix}_error_overlap.png\'\n    fig.savefig(path)\n    plt.close(fig)\n    panels.append(image_html(\n        path,\n        f\'{recorded_label or "Current comparison"}. A is {a}; B is {b}. \'\n        \'On sampled positive/negative pairs: \'\n        f\'A wrong and B correct {values[0]:.2f}%; \'\n        f\'B wrong and A correct {values[1]:.2f}%; \'\n        f\'both strictly wrong {values[2]:.2f}%. Ties are excluded from these bars.\',\n    ))\n    return panels\n\n\ndef quality_sentence(report, comparison):\n    labels = {\'xgboost\':\'XGBoost\', \'tabpfn35\':\'TabPFN35\'}\n    a, b = (escape(labels.get(str(name).casefold(), str(name))) for name in report.candidate.tolist())\n    if \'delta_b_minus_a\' not in comparison:\n        return (\'The quality of these two files is unknown. \'\n                \'Their test differences show how predictions vary; \'\n                \'add both OOF files and labels to compare AUC.\')\n    d = comparison[\'delta_b_minus_a\']\n    lo, hi = comparison[\'conditional_low95\'], comparison[\'conditional_high95\']\n    if d > 0:\n        result = f\'{b} has {auc_text(d)} higher AUC than {a} on these fixed OOF scores.\'\n    elif d < 0:\n        result = f\'{a} has {auc_text(-d)} higher AUC than {b} on these fixed OOF scores.\'\n    else:\n        result = f\'{a} and {b} have the same AUC on these fixed OOF scores.\'\n    result += (\' The conditional 95% interval for B minus A is \'\n               f\'[{auc_text(lo, True)}, {auc_text(hi, True)}].\')\n    if lo <= 0 <= hi:\n        result += \' That interval includes zero.\'\n    return result\n\n\ndef show_comparison(report, comparison, out, table_html, candidate_table=\'\'):\n    a, b = report.candidate.tolist()\n    parts = [candidate_table, note_html(quality_sentence(report, comparison)),\n             f\'<p style="margin:8px 0;"><b>A:</b> {escape(a)} &nbsp; <b>B:</b> {escape(b)}</p>\']\n    panels = comparison_panels(report, comparison, out)\n    if panels:\n        parts.append(\'<div>\'+\'\'.join(panels)+\'</div>\')\n        pairs = comparison[\'ranking_pairs\']\n        parts.append(\n            \'<p style="margin:10px 0;">\'\n            f"The diagnostic sampled <b>{pairs[\'sampled_pairs\']:,}</b> positive/negative pairs "\n            f"with seed {pairs[\'seed\']}. def ft_find(slug, local, filename):
    if Path(local, filename).is_file():
        return Path(local)
    ft_matches = [p.parent for p in Path('/kaggle/input').rglob(filename) if slug.split('/')[-1] in p.parts]
    if len(ft_matches) != 1:
        raise ValueError(f'Attach {slug}; found {len(ft_matches)} matching directories')
    return ft_matches[0]

def ft_table_html(frame, formats=None):
    styled = frame.style.hide(axis='index')
    styled = styled.format(formats or {}, na_rep='unknown', escape='html')
    return styled.set_properties(**{'font-size':'13px'}).set_table_styles(
        [{'selector':'th','props':[('font-size','13px')]}]
    ).to_html()

def ft_table(frame, formats=None):
    display(HTML(ft_table_html(frame, formats)))

(FT_OUT/"paired_metrics.py").write_text('import numpy as np\nfrom sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score\n\ndef paired_auc(y, a, b):\n    """Conditional paired DeLong interval for AUC(B) minus AUC(A)."""\n    def placements(p):\n        pos, neg = p[y == 1], p[y == 0]\n        sp, sn = np.sort(pos), np.sort(neg)\n        pos_left = np.searchsorted(sn, pos, \'left\')\n        pos_right = np.searchsorted(sn, pos, \'right\')\n        neg_left = np.searchsorted(sp, neg, \'left\')\n        neg_right = np.searchsorted(sp, neg, \'right\')\n        vpos = (pos_left + pos_right) / (2 * len(neg))\n        vneg = 1 - (neg_left + neg_right) / (2 * len(pos))\n        return vpos, vneg\n    ap, an = placements(a)\n    bp, bn = placements(b)\n    delta = float(roc_auc_score(y, b) - roc_auc_score(y, a))\n    variance = (\n        np.var(bp - ap, ddof=1) / len(ap)\n        + np.var(bn - an, ddof=1) / len(an)\n    )\n    se = float(np.sqrt(variance))\n    return dict(\n        delta_b_minus_a=delta, conditional_se=se,\n        conditional_low95=delta - 1.96 * se,\n        conditional_high95=delta + 1.96 * se,\n    )\n\ndef rank_error_overlap(y, a, b, pair_count=200000, seed=20261015):\n    """Sample ranking errors; the diagnostic reports ties separately."""\n    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)\n    ip = rng.choice(np.flatnonzero(y == 1), pair_count)\n    inn = rng.choice(np.flatnonzero(y == 0), pair_count)\n    def loss(p):\n        wrong = (p[ip] < p[inn]).astype(float)\n        tied = p[ip] == p[inn]\n        return wrong + .5 * tied\n    ea, eb = loss(a), loss(b)\n    return dict(\n        sampled_pairs=pair_count, seed=seed,\n        ranking_loss_a=float(ea.mean()),\n        ranking_loss_b=float(eb.mean()),\n        both_strictly_wrong_pct=100 * float(\n            np.mean((ea == 1) & (eb == 1))),\n        a_wrong_b_correct_pct=100 * float(\n            np.mean((ea == 1) & (eb == 0))),\n        b_wrong_a_correct_pct=100 * float(\n            np.mean((eb == 1) & (ea == 0))),\n        at_least_one_tie_pct=100 * float(\n            np.mean((ea == .5) | (eb == .5))),\n    )\n')

(FT_OUT/'addone_audit.py').write_text('"""Conditional cross-fitted comparison of a supplied OOF pool with one extra column."""\nimport hashlib\nimport json\nimport time\nimport warnings\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport numpy as np\nimport pandas as pd\nfrom scipy.special import logit\nfrom scipy.stats import norm\nfrom sklearn.exceptions import ConvergenceWarning\nfrom sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression\nfrom sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score\nfrom sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold\nfrom threadpoolctl import threadpool_limits\n\n\ndef file_hash(path):\n    h = hashlib.sha256()\n    with Path(path).open(\'rb\') as source:\n        for block in iter(lambda: source.read(1 << 20), b\'\'):\n            h.update(block)\n    return h.hexdigest()\n\n\ndef array_hash(a):\n    return hashlib.sha256(np.ascontiguousarray(a).tobytes()).hexdigest()\n\n\ndef paired_difference(y, base, expanded, comparisons):\n    """DeLong approximation conditional on the supplied, fitted prediction vectors."""\n    def placements(p):\n        pos, neg = p[y == 1], p[y == 0]\n        sp, sn = np.sort(pos), np.sort(neg)\n        vp = (np.searchsorted(sn, pos, \'left\') + np.searchsorted(sn, pos, \'right\')) / (2 * len(neg))\n        vn = 1 - (np.searchsorted(sp, neg, \'left\') + np.searchsorted(sp, neg, \'right\')) / (2 * len(pos))\n        return vp, vn\n    ap, an = placements(base)\n    bp, bn = placements(expanded)\n    delta = float(roc_auc_score(y, expanded) - roc_auc_score(y, base))\n    se = float(np.sqrt(np.var(bp - ap, ddof=1) / len(ap) + np.var(bn - an, ddof=1) / len(an)))\n    z = float(norm.ppf(1 - .05 / (2 * comparisons)))\n    return dict(delta=delta, conditional_se=se,\n                low95=delta - 1.96 * se, high95=delta + 1.96 * se,\n                adjusted_low=delta - z * se, adjusted_high=delta + z * se)\n\n\ndef prepare_scores(ids, y, scores, pools, candidate, scales, seeds, c):\n    ids, y = np.asarray(ids), np.asarray(y)\n    if ids.ndim != 1 or y.shape != ids.shape or len(ids) < 10:\n        raise ValueError(\'IDs and labels must be equal-length one-dimensional arrays, with at least 10 rows.\')\n    if pd.isna(ids).any() or pd.Index(ids).has_duplicates:\n        raise ValueError(\'IDs must be present and unique; join files by ID before this audit.\')\n    if not np.isin(y, [0, 1]).all() or min(np.sum(y == 0), np.sum(y == 1)) < 5:\n        raise ValueError(\'Labels must be 0/1, with at least five rows in each class.\')\n    if not seeds or len(set(seeds)) != len(seeds) or any(not isinstance(s, (int, np.integer)) for s in seeds):\n        raise ValueError(\'Provide distinct integer split seeds.\')\n    if not np.isfinite(c) or c <= 0 or not pools:\n        raise ValueError(\'C must be positive and at least one reference pool is required.\')\n    used = set([candidate])\n    for name, members in pools.items():\n        if not members or len(set(members)) != len(members) or candidate in members:\n            raise ValueError(f\'{name}: use unique base columns and keep the candidate out of the base pool.\')\n        used.update(members)\n    z = {}\n    for name in sorted(used):\n        if name not in scores or name not in scales:\n            raise ValueError(f\'Missing score column or explicit scale: {name}\')\n        v = np.asarray(scores[name], dtype=np.float64)\n        if v.shape != y.shape or not np.isfinite(v).all():\n            raise ValueError(f\'{name}: scores must be finite and match all labelled rows.\')\n        if scales[name] == \'probability\':\n            if v.min() < 0 or v.max() > 1:\n                raise ValueError(f\'{name}: probability scores must lie in [0, 1].\')\n            z[name] = logit(np.clip(v, 1e-6, 1 - 1e-6))\n        elif scales[name] == \'logit\':\n            z[name] = v.copy()\n        else:\n            raise ValueError(f\'{name}: scale must be probability or logit.\')\n    for name in used - {candidate}:\n        if np.array_equal(z[candidate], z[name]):\n            raise ValueError(f\'The candidate is identical to base column {name} after transformation. It is not new input.\')\n    order = pd.Series(ids).sort_values(kind=\'stable\').index.to_numpy()\n    return ids[order], y[order].astype(np.int8), {name: value[order] for name, value in z.items()}\n\n\ndef load_score_csv(path, id_column, label_column, columns):\n    frame = pd.read_csv(path)\n    if len(set(columns)) != len(columns) or id_column in columns or label_column in columns:\n        raise ValueError(\'Score names must be distinct and exclude the ID and label columns.\')\n    expected = [id_column, label_column] + list(columns)\n    missing = sorted(set(expected) - set(frame.columns))\n    if missing:\n        raise ValueError(f\'Missing columns: {missing}. Labels and true excluded-row predictions are required.\')\n    return frame[id_column].to_numpy(), frame[label_column].to_numpy(), {\n        name: frame[name].to_numpy() for name in columns}\n\n\ndef audit_addone(ids, y, scores, pools, candidate, scales, seeds, c, out,\n                 source_note, keep_predictions=False, comparison_family_size=None):\n    """Refit each specified base and expanded combiner on the same five folds."""\n    started = time.perf_counter()\n    ids, y, z = prepare_scores(ids, y, scores, pools, candidate, scales, seeds, c)\n    out = Path(out)\n    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    comparisons = len(pools) * len(seeds)\n    if comparison_family_size is not None:\n        if not isinstance(comparison_family_size, int) or comparison_family_size < comparisons:\n            raise ValueError(\'Comparison family must include every planned comparison in this call.\')\n        comparisons = comparison_family_size\n    rows, fold_rows, fits, predictions = [], [], [], {}\n    manifest = dict(rows=len(y), candidate=candidate, pools=pools, scales=scales,\n                    split_seeds=list(seeds), folds=5, C=c, clip_probability=1e-6,\n                    comparisons=comparisons, source_note=source_note,\n                    scope=\'Conditional supplied-OOF diagnostic; not end-to-end nested validation or a final-slot recommendation.\',\n                    labels_sha256=array_hash(y), transformed_score_sha256={n: array_hash(v) for n, v in z.items()},\n                    fold_assignment_sha256={}, prediction_sha256={})\n    with threadpool_limits(limits=1), warnings.catch_warnings():\n        warnings.simplefilter(\'error\', ConvergenceWarning)\n        for seed in seeds:\n            folds = list(StratifiedKFold(5, shuffle=True, random_state=seed).split(np.zeros(len(y)), y))\n            assignment = np.full(len(y), -1, dtype=np.int8)\n            for fold, (_, valid) in enumerate(folds):\n                assignment[valid] = fold\n            assert (assignment >= 0).all()\n            assignment_path = out / f\'folds_seed{seed}.csv\'\n            pd.DataFrame({\'id\': ids, \'meta_fold\': assignment}).to_csv(assignment_path, index=False)\n            manifest[\'fold_assignment_sha256\'][str(seed)] = file_hash(assignment_path)\n            for pool, members in pools.items():\n                columns = members + [candidate]\n                x = np.column_stack([z[n] for n in columns])\n                base, expanded = np.full(len(y), np.nan), np.full(len(y), np.nan)\n                coverage = np.zeros(len(y), dtype=np.int8)\n                for fold, (train, valid) in enumerate(folds):\n                    assert not np.intersect1d(train, valid).size\n                    outputs = []\n                    for kind, width in [(\'base\', len(members)), (\'expanded\', len(columns))]:\n                        model = LogisticRegression(C=c, solver=\'lbfgs\', tol=1e-7, max_iter=2000)\n                        model.fit(x[train, :width], y[train])\n                        assert model.n_iter_[0] < 2000\n                        pred = model.decision_function(x[valid, :width])\n                        outputs.append(pred)\n                        fits.append(dict(pool=pool, seed=seed, fold=fold, kind=kind,\n                                         members=columns[:width], coefficients=model.coef_[0].tolist(),\n                                         intercept=float(model.intercept_[0]), iterations=int(model.n_iter_[0]),\n                                         train_rows=len(train), validation_rows=len(valid)))\n                    base[valid], expanded[valid] = outputs\n                    coverage[valid] += 1\n                    ba, ea = (float(roc_auc_score(y[valid], p)) for p in outputs)\n                    fold_rows.append(dict(pool=pool, seed=seed, fold=fold, base_auc=ba, expanded_auc=ea, delta=ea-ba))\n                assert (coverage == 1).all() and np.isfinite(base).all() and np.isfinite(expanded).all()\n                d = paired_difference(y, base, expanded, comparisons)\n                positive = sum(r[\'delta\'] > 0 for r in fold_rows if r[\'pool\'] == pool and r[\'seed\'] == seed)\n                rows.append(dict(pool=pool, seed=seed, members=len(members),\n                                 base_auc=float(roc_auc_score(y, base)), expanded_auc=float(roc_auc_score(y, expanded)),\n                                 positive_folds=positive, **d))\n                key = f\'{pool}_seed{seed}\'\n                manifest[\'prediction_sha256\'][key] = dict(base=array_hash(base), expanded=array_hash(expanded))\n                if keep_predictions:\n                    predictions[key] = dict(base=base, expanded=expanded, assignment=assignment.copy(), coverage=coverage)\n                print(f\'Add-one audit: {pool}, seed {seed}, completed 5 combiner folds.\', flush=True)\n    summary, by_fold = pd.DataFrame(rows), pd.DataFrame(fold_rows)\n    manifest[\'candidate_standalone_auc\'] = float(roc_auc_score(y, z[candidate]))\n    manifest[\'elapsed_seconds\'] = time.perf_counter() - started\n    summary.to_csv(out / \'addone_summary.csv\', index=False)\n    by_fold.to_csv(out / \'addone_folds.csv\', index=False)\n    (out / \'addone_fits.json\').write_text(json.dumps(fits, indent=2))\n    (out / \'addone_manifest.json\').write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2))\n    return summary, by_fold, manifest, predictions\n')

plt.subplots(figsize=(8.1, max(2.8, .55 * len(pools) + 1.2)), layout=\'constrained\')\n    colors = [\'#0072B2\', \'#D55E00\', \'#009E73\', \'#CC79A7\']\n    markers = [\'o\', \'s\', \'^\', \'D\']\n    offsets = np.linspace(-.13, .13, len(seeds)) if len(seeds) > 1 else [0]\n    for j, (seed, offset) in enumerate(zip(seeds, offsets)):\n        frame = summary[summary.seed.eq(seed)].set_index(\'pool\').loc[pools]\n        d = frame.delta.to_numpy() * 1e4\n        lower = frame.adjusted_low.to_numpy() * 1e4\n        upper = frame.adjusted_high.to_numpy() * 1e4\n        ax.errorbar(d, np.arange(len(pools)) + offset,\n                    xerr=np.vstack([d-lower, upper-d]), fmt=markers[j % len(markers)],\n                    color=colors[j % len(colors)], capsize=3, ms=6, lw=1.6,\n                    label=f\'Split seed {seed}\')\n    ax.axvline(0, color=\'#555\', lw=1)\n    ax.set_yticks(np.arange(len(pools)), pools, fontsize=11)\n    ax.invert_yaxis()\n    ax.set_ylim(len(pools)-.5, -.65)\n    lo = min(0, float(summary.adjusted_low.min()) * 1e4)\n    hi = max(0, float(summary.adjusted_high.max()) * 1e4)\n    margin = max((hi-lo)*.06, .02)\n    ax.set_xlim(lo-margin, hi+margin)\n    ax.set_title(f\'Adding {manifest["candidate"]} to the specified pools\', fontsize=13, loc=\'left\', pad=10)\n    ax.set_xlabel(\'Change in pooled meta-OOF AUC (× 0.0001)\', fontsize=11)\n    ax.tick_params(axis=\'x\', labelsize=10)\n    ax.grid(axis=\'y\', visible=False)\n    ax.legend(loc=\'lower left\', bbox_to_anchor=(0, 1.0), ncol=min(2,len(seeds)),\n              fontsize=9, frameon=False, borderaxespad=0)\n    # Keep the title above the legend so both remain outside the data region.\n    ax.set_title(f\'Adding {manifest["candidate"]} to the specified pools\', fontsize=13,\n                 loc=\'left\', y=1.18, pad=8)\n    image = BytesIO()\n    fig.savefig(out/\'addone_gain.png\', dpi=730/8.1, bbox_inches=\'tight\')\n    fig.savefig(image, format=\'png\', dpi=730/8.1, bbox_inches=\'tight\')\n    plt.close(fig)\n    encoded = base64.b64encode(image.getvalue()).decode()\n    alt = html.escape(f\'Paired meta-OOF AUC change from adding {manifest["candidate"]}; \'\n                      f\'each reference pool and split seed is shown with an approximate multiplicity-adjusted interval.\')\n    display(HTML(f\'<img src="data:image/png;base64,{encoded}" alt="{alt}" \'\n                 \'style="display:block;width:100%;max-width:730px;height:auto;margin:8px auto;">\'))\n    smallest, largest = float(summary.delta.min()), float(summary.delta.max())\n    positive = int((summary.delta > 0).sum())\n    if positive == len(summary):\n        sentence = f\'All {len(summary)} pooled differences are positive: {smallest:+.6f} to {largest:+.6f} AUC.\'\n    elif positive == 0:\n        sentence = f\'None of the {len(summary)} pooled differences is positive; the range is {smallest:+.6f} to {largest:+.6f} AUC.\'\n    else:\n        sentence = f\'{positive} of {len(summary)} pooled differences are positive; the range is {smallest:+.6f} to {largest:+.6f} AUC.\'\n    display(Markdown(sentence + \' These are changes under the specified refit procedure, not private-board estimates.\'))\n    if manifest[\'candidate_standalone_auc\'] > summary.base_auc.max():\n        display(Markdown(\'The candidate alone scores above all reference pools here. \'\n                         \'Positive add-one differences do not by themselves demonstrate a benefit from model diversity.\'))\n    frame = summary[[\'pool\',\'seed\',\'base_auc\',\'expanded_auc\',\'delta\',\'positive_folds\']].copy()\n    frame[\'positive_folds\'] = frame.positive_folds.map(lambda n:f\'{n}/5\')\n    frame.columns = [\'Reference\',\'Split seed\',\'Base AUC\',\'With candidate\',\'Δ AUC\',\'Positive folds\']\n    display(HTML(table_html(frame, {\'Base AUC\':\'{:.6f}\', \'With They treat score pairs as independent within classes and omit dependence from "\n        "cross-fitting, upstream training and model selection; nominal coverage is not guaranteed. np\nimport pandas as pd\nfrom sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score\nfrom addone_audit import audit_addone, file_hash\n\n\ndef audit_reverse(ids, y, scores, reference, candidates, scales, seeds, c, out,\n                  source_note, keep_predictions=False):\n    if not candidates or len(set(candidates)) != len(candidates) or reference in candidates:\n        raise ValueError(\'Use distinct candidates and exclude the reference column.\')\n    out = Path(out)\n    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    started = time.perf_counter()\n    family = len(candidates) * len(seeds)\n    summaries, folds, predictions = [], [], {}\n    baseline_hashes, split_hashes = {}, {}\n    for i, candidate in enumerate(candidates):\n        target = out / f\'candidate_{i+1}\'\n        summary, by_fold, manifest, pred = audit_addone(\n            ids, y, scores, {reference:[reference]}, candidate, scales, seeds, c,\n            target, source_note, keep_predictions, comparison_family_size=family)\n        for seed in seeds:\n            key = f\'{reference}_seed{seed}\'\n            h = manifest[\'prediction_sha256\'][key][\'base\']\n            split = manifest[\'fold_assignment_sha256\'][str(seed)]\n            if seed in baseline_hashes:\n                assert baseline_hashes[seed] == h and split_hashes[seed] == split\n            baseline_hashes[seed], split_hashes[seed] = h, split\n        fits = json.loads((target/\'addone_fits.json\').read_text())\n        assert all(row[\'coefficients\'][0] > 0 for row in fits if row[\'kind\']==\'base\')\n        summary.insert(0, \'candidate\', candidate)\n        by_fold.insert(0, \'candidate\', candidate)\n        summaries.append(summary)\n        folds.append(by_fold)\n        if keep_predictions:\n            predictions[candidate] = pred\n    summary, by_fold = pd.concat(summaries, ignore_index=True), pd.concat(folds, ignore_index=True)\n    summary.to_csv(out/\'reverse_summary.csv\', index=False)\n    by_fold.to_csv(out/\'reverse_folds.csv\', index=False)\n    receipt = dict(reference=reference, candidates=list(candidates),     episodes[[\'episode\',\'competition\']],left_on=\'comp_slug\',right_on=\'competition\',validate=\'one_to_one\')\n    if set(scope.episode)!=set(info[\'episodes\']) or not scope.higher_is_better.all():\n        raise ValueError(\'Historical competition scope does not match the existing audit.\')\n    boards=pd.read_csv(boards_dir/\'s6_leaderboards.csv\')\n    eligible=boards[boards.episode.isin(scope.episode)&~boards.is_host_baseline &\n                    boards.public_rank.notna()&boards.private_rank.notna()][[\'episode\',\'team_id\']]\n    columns=[\'comp_id\',\'team_id\',\'sub_id\',\'submitted\',\'public_score\',\'private_score\',\'board_reproduces\']\n    data=pd.read_parquet(histories_dir/\'submissions.parquet\',columns=columns,filters=[(\'comp_id\',\'in\',scope.comp_id.tolist())])\n    if not data.sub_id.is_unique or not data.board_reproduces.all():raise ValueError(\'Source IDs or board validation failed.\')\n    data=data.merge(scope[[\'comp_id\',\'episode\']],on=\'comp_id\',validate=\'many_to_one\').merge(\n        eligible,on=[\'episode\',\'team_id\'],validate=\'many_to_one\')\n    if len(data)!=info[\'matched_rows\']:raise ValueError(\'Different historical rows from the first audit.\')\n    data[\'rounded\']=data.public_score.map(lambda x:Decimal(str(x)).quantize(Decimal(\'0.00001\'),rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP))\n    keys=[\'episode\',\'team_id\'];counts=data.groupby(keys).size()\n    data=data.merge(counts[counts.ge(2)].rename(\'n\'),left_on=keys,right_index=True)\n    def choose(column):\n        q=data.sort_values(keys+[column,\'submitted\',\'sub_id\'],ascending=[True,True,False,True,True]).copy()\n        q[\'order\']=q.groupby(keys).cumcount()\n        a=q[q.order.eq(0)].set_index(keys);b=q[q.order.eq(1)].set_index(keys)\n        return pd.DataFrame({\'a\':a.sub_id,\'b\':b.sub_id,\'a_score\':a[column],\'b_score\':b[column]})\n    full,rounded=choose(\'public_score\'),choose(\'rounded\')\n    if not full.index.equals(rounded.index) or full.isna().any().any() or rounded.isna().any().any():\n        raise ValueError(\'The two rules must compare the same eligible teams.\')\n    full[\'changed\']=[{a,b}!={c,d} for a,b,c,d in zip(full.a,full.b,rounded.a,rounded.b)]\n    full[\'strict\']=full.a_score.gt(full.b_score);rounded[\'strict\']=rounded.a_score.gt(rounded.b_score)\n    rows=[];existing=history.set_index(\'episode\')\n    for episode in info[\'episodes\']:\n        a,b=full.loc[episode],rounded.loc[episode];reference=existing.loc[episode]\n        if len(a)!=reference.teams_with_two or a.strict.sum()!=reference.strict_pairs:\n            raise ValueError(\'The full-precision population differs from the existing audit.\')\n        rows.append(dict(episode=episode,eligible_teams=len(a),changed_pairs=int(a.changed.sum()),\n            full_strict_pairs=int(a.strict.sum()),rounded_strict_pairs=int(b.strict.sum()),\n            full_ties=int((~a.strict).sum()),rounded_ties=int((~b.strict).sum())))\n    result=pd.DataFrame(rows);result.to_csv(out/\'history_precision.csv\',index=False)\n    (out/\'history_precision_scope.json\').write_text(json.dumps({\n      \'episodes\':info[\'episodes\'],\'method\':\'Compare full-precision scores to hypothetical 5-decimal ROUND_HALF_UP; ties by time then submission ID.\',\n      \'limitation\':\'Rounding and precision are not verified as historical user-interface behavior.\',\n      \'selection\':\'Both rules use the same matched, non-host teams with two scored files; strict denominators can differ.\'},indent=2))\n    return result\n')

_ = (AO_OUT/'default_public_protocol.md').write_text("# Public add-one audit, frozen before this calculation\n\nPurpose: demonstrate how the conditional incremental value of the same candidate depends on the specified public reference pool. No assumption that larger pools score better or that the candidate becomes redundant. Publish all three comparisons and both seeds regardless of direction. No private recipe, current competition submission, or final-slot change.\n\nData: the existing public cdeotte/s6e10-tfm-oof-and-test-predictions archive. The author describes all entries as single-family outputs using the 21 raw features and five stratified folds with seed 42; bare arrays have no IDs. Treat this as a source declaration, not independent proof of upstream training or row alignment. Record exact OOF and train-file hashes; fail on changes in demo mode. No prediction arrays are republished in Output.\n\nCandidate: TabPFN35. Reference pools, fixed by family rather than by the new scores:\n1. XGBoost.\n2. XGBoost + RealMLP.\n3. XGBoost + RealMLP + TabICL2 + TabFM.\n\nThe named candidate is excluded from each pool. No claim that ancestry is independently audited. Compare logistic refits of each base pool against logistic refits of the same pool plus candidate. This is not a fixed blend of two final submissions, nor a comparison against an unpublished competition stack.\n\nTransform: probabilities clipped to [1e-6, 1-1e-6] then logit. No standardization, feature search, weights search, model selection or early stopping. LogisticRegression(C=1, solver=lbfgs, tol=1e-7, max_iter=2000), intercept fitted, one CPU thread. Rows are sorted by ID before split construction. Identical saved assignments are used by every pool within each seed. Failure to converge invalidates the run. Fold assignment: StratifiedKFold(5, shuffle=True), seeds 42 and 20261029. Each row is scored by a combiner that did not fit that row's label. Public base-model fitting and selection remain outside this nesting. Historical public OOF rows were previously inspected; these are not an untouched holdout.\n\nReport for each pool and seed: pooled base and expanded meta-OOF AUC, paired difference, five fold differences, positive-fold count, and a conditional paired DeLong interval. The primary family has six contrasts (three pools times two seeds); use Bonferroni-adjusted intervals across that family, without pretending the two partitions are independent replication. Report pointwise intervals in machine-readable output only. All intervals omit uncertainty from retraining, overlapping training folds and historical selection; no certification of private performance or final slots.\n\nCandidate standalone AUC is descriptive. Report baseline AUC for every pool so a gain can be interpreted relative to the reference. Do not use a baseline-size curve to claim a causal law of saturation. No materially useful effect threshold is invented after results.\n\nReader mode: accept a CSV with id, 0/1 label, base score columns and one candidate column, explicit scales, seeds and C. Validate unique IDs, binary labels, finite scores, probabilities in [0,1], at least five members of each class, no candidate/base column overlap, and no identical transformed candidate/base vector. All columns must share row alignment and true excluded-row predictions. The tool can verify schema and equality, not the OOF production history. CSV mode emits its own results, not the public demo's prose. It produces a diagnostic, not submission.csv.\n\nEvidence and reproducibility: store protocol and input hashes, fold assignments, fitted coefficients and convergence counts, unrounded summary, all fold results, and source declarations. Independently recompute pooled AUC by rank sums and verify all validation-row coverage and candidate-minus-base deltas. Check a synthetic duplicate candidate, shuffled rows, absent labels, nonfinite scores, and nonbinary labels. No public push until a complete local run, critics, explicit humanizer and rendered QA pass.\n\n## Statistical interpretation checked before execution\n\nThe effect is the change in meta-OOF AUC under the specified logistic-refit procedure, not an isolated measure of new information. Approximate paired DeLong intervals treat score pairs as independent observations within outcome classes. They omit cross-fitting and upstream dependencies, and nominal coverage is not guaranteed. Bonferroni handles the six planned comparisons under that approximation; it cannot repair those dependencies. Seeds and folds are sensitivity descriptions rather than independent replications. Crossing zero does not establish equivalence or redundancy. Jointly shuffled rows remain aligned and are sorted by ID; a score-only shuffle cannot be detected from schema alone.\n")

_ = (AO_OUT/"frozen_v21_addone_audit.py").write_text('"""Conditional cross-fitted comparison of a supplied OOF pool with one extra column."""\nimport hashlib\nimport json\nimport time\nimport warnings\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport numpy as np\nimport pandas as pd\nfrom scipy.special import logit\nfrom scipy.stats import norm\nfrom sklearn.exceptions import ConvergenceWarning\nfrom sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression\nfrom sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score\nfrom sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold\nfrom threadpoolctl import threadpool_limits\n\n\ndef file_hash(path):\n    h = hashlib.sha256()\n    with Path(path).open(\'rb\') as source:\n        for block in iter(lambda: source.read(1 << 20), b\'\'):\n            h.update(block)\n    return h.hexdigest()\n\n\ndef array_hash(a):\n    return hashlib.sha256(np.ascontiguousarray(a).tobytes()).hexdigest()\n\n\ndef paired_difference(y, base, expanded, comparisons):\n    """DeLong approximation conditional on the supplied, fitted prediction vectors."""\n    def placements(p):\n        pos, neg = p[y == 1], p[y == 0]\n        sp, sn = np.sort(pos), np.sort(neg)\n        vp = (np.searchsorted(sn, pos, \'left\') + np.searchsorted(sn, pos, \'right\')) / (2 * len(neg))\n        vn = 1 - (np.searchsorted(sp, neg, \'left\') + np.searchsorted(sp, neg, \'right\')) / (2 * len(pos))\n        return vp, vn\n    ap, an = placements(base)\n    bp, bn = placements(expanded)\n    delta = float(roc_auc_score(y, expanded) - roc_auc_score(y, base))\n    se = float(np.sqrt(np.var(bp - ap, ddof=1) / len(ap) + np.var(bn - an, ddof=1) / len(an)))\n    z = float(norm.ppf(1 - .05 / (2 * comparisons)))\n    return dict(delta=delta, conditional_se=se,\n                low95=delta - 1.96 * se, high95=delta + 1.96 * se,\n                adjusted_low=delta - z * se, adjusted_high=delta + z * se)\n\n\ndef prepare_scores(ids, y, scores, pools, candidate, scales, seeds, c):\n    ids, y = np.asarray(ids), np.asarray(y)\n    if ids.ndim != 1 or y.shape != ids.shape or len(ids) < 10:\n        raise ValueError(\'IDs and labels must be equal-length one-dimensional arrays, with at least 10 rows.\')\n    if pd.isna(ids).any() or pd.Index(ids).has_duplicates:\n        raise ValueError(\'IDs must be present and unique; join files by ID before this audit.\')\n    if not np.isin(y, [0, 1]).all() or min(np.sum(y == 0), np.sum(y == 1)) < 5:\n        raise ValueError(\'Labels must be 0/1, with at least five rows in each class.\')\n    if not seeds or len(set(seeds)) != len(seeds) or any(not isinstance(s, (int, np.integer)) for s in seeds):\n        raise ValueError(\'Provide distinct integer split seeds.\')\n    if not np.isfinite(c) or c <= 0 or not pools:\n        raise ValueError(\'C must be positive and at least one reference pool is required.\')\n    used = set([candidate])\n    for name, members in pools.items():\n        if not members or len(set(members)) != len(members) or candidate in members:\n            raise ValueError(f\'{name}: use unique base columns and keep the candidate out of the base pool.\')\n        used.update(members)\n    z = {}\n    for name in sorted(used):\n        if name not in scores or name not in scales:\n            raise ValueError(f\'Missing score column or explicit scale: {name}\')\n        v = np.asarray(scores[name], dtype=np.float64)\n        if v.shape != y.shape or not np.isfinite(v).all():\n            raise ValueError(f\'{name}: scores must be finite and match all labelled rows.\')\n        if scales[name] == \'probability\':\n            if v.min() < 0 or v.max() > 1:\n                raise ValueError(f\'{name}: probability scores must lie in [0, 1].\')\n            z[name] = logit(np.clip(v, 1e-6, 1 - 1e-6))\n        elif scales[name] == \'logit\':\n            z[name] = v.copy()\n        else:\n            raise ValueError(f\'{name}: scale must be probability or logit.\')\n    for name in used - {candidate}:\n        if np.array_equal(z[candidate], z[name]):\n            raise ValueError(f\'The candidate is identical to base column {name} after transformation. It is not new input.\')\n    order = pd.Series(ids).sort_values(kind=\'stable\').index.to_numpy()\n    return ids[order], y[order].astype(np.int8), {name: value[order] for name, value in z.items()}\n\n\ndef load_score_csv(path, id_column, label_column, columns):\n    frame = pd.read_csv(path)\n    if len(set(columns)) != len(columns) or id_column in columns or label_column in columns:\n        raise ValueError(\'Score names must be distinct and exclude the ID and label columns.\')\n    expected = [id_column, label_column] + list(columns)\n    missing = sorted(set(expected) - set(frame.columns))\n    if missing:\n        raise ValueError(f\'Missing columns: {missing}. Labels and true excluded-row predictions are required.\')\n    return frame[id_column].to_numpy(), frame[label_column].to_numpy(), {\n        name: frame[name].to_numpy() for name in columns}\n\n\ndef audit_addone(ids, y, scores, pools, candidate, scales, seeds, c, out,\n                 source_note, keep_predictions=False):\n    """Refit each specified base and expanded combiner on the same five folds."""\n    started = time.perf_counter()\n    ids, y, z = prepare_scores(ids, y, scores, pools, candidate, scales, seeds, c)\n    out = Path(out)\n    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    comparisons = len(pools) * len(seeds)\n    rows, fold_rows, fits, predictions = [], [], [], {}\n    manifest = dict(rows=len(y), candidate=candidate, pools=pools, scales=scales,\n                    split_seeds=list(seeds), folds=5, C=c, clip_probability=1e-6,\n                    comparisons=comparisons, source_note=source_note,\n                    scope=\'Conditional supplied-OOF diagnostic; not end-to-end nested validation or a final-slot recommendation.\',\n                    labels_sha256=array_hash(y), transformed_score_sha256={n: array_hash(v) for n, v in z.items()},\n                    fold_assignment_sha256={}, prediction_sha256={})\n    with threadpool_limits(limits=1), warnings.catch_warnings():\n        warnings.simplefilter(\'error\', ConvergenceWarning)\n        for seed in seeds:\n            folds = list(StratifiedKFold(5, shuffle=True, random_state=seed).split(np.zeros(len(y)), y))\n            assignment = np.full(len(y), -1, dtype=np.int8)\n            for fold, (_, valid) in enumerate(folds):\n                assignment[valid] = fold\n            assert (assignment >= 0).all()\n            assignment_path = out / f\'folds_seed{seed}.csv\'\n            pd.DataFrame({\'id\': ids, \'meta_fold\': assignment}).to_csv(assignment_path, index=False)\n            manifest[\'fold_assignment_sha256\'][str(seed)] = file_hash(assignment_path)\n            for pool, members in pools.items():\n                columns = members + [candidate]\n                x = np.column_stack([z[n] for n in columns])\n                base, expanded = np.full(len(y), np.nan), np.full(len(y), np.nan)\n                coverage = np.zeros(len(y), dtype=np.int8)\n                for fold, (train, valid) in enumerate(folds):\n                    assert not np.intersect1d(train, valid).size\n                    outputs = []\n                    for kind, width in [(\'base\', len(members)), (\'expanded\', len(columns))]:\n                        model = LogisticRegression(C=c, solver=\'lbfgs\', tol=1e-7, max_iter=2000)\n                        model.fit(x[train, :width], y[train])\n                        assert model.n_iter_[0] < 2000\n                        pred = model.decision_function(x[valid, :width])\n                        outputs.append(pred)\n                        fits.append(dict(pool=pool, seed=seed, fold=fold, kind=kind,\n                                         members=columns[:width], coefficients=model.coef_[0].tolist(),\n                                         intercept=float(model.intercept_[0]), iterations=int(model.n_iter_[0]),\n                                         train_rows=len(train), validation_rows=len(valid)))\n                    base[valid], expanded[valid] = outputs\n                    coverage[valid] += 1\n                    ba, ea = (float(roc_auc_score(y[valid], p)) for p in outputs)\n                    fold_rows.append(dict(pool=pool, seed=seed, fold=fold, base_auc=ba, expanded_auc=ea, delta=ea-ba))\n                assert (coverage == 1).all() and np.isfinite(base).all() and np.isfinite(expanded).all()\n                d = paired_difference(y, base, expanded, comparisons)\n                positive = sum(r[\'delta\'] > 0 for r in fold_rows if r[\'pool\'] == pool and r[\'seed\'] == seed)\n                rows.append(dict(pool=pool, seed=seed, members=len(members),\n                                 base_auc=float(roc_auc_score(y, base)), expanded_auc=float(roc_auc_score(y, expanded)),\n                                 positive_folds=positive, **d))\n                key = f\'{pool}_seed{seed}\'\n                manifest[\'prediction_sha256\'][key] = dict(base=array_hash(base), expanded=array_hash(expanded))\n                if keep_predictions:\n                    predictions[key] = dict(base=base, expanded=expanded, assignment=assignment.copy(), coverage=coverage)\n                print(f\'Add-one audit: {pool}, seed {seed}, completed 5 combiner folds.\', flush=True)\n    summary, by_fold = pd.DataFrame(rows), pd.DataFrame(fold_rows)\n    manifest[\'candidate_standalone_auc\'] = float(roc_auc_score(y, z[candidate]))\n    manifest[\'elapsed_seconds\'] = time.perf_counter() - started\n    summary.to_csv(out / \'addone_summary.csv\', index=False)\n    by_fold.to_csv(out / \'addone_folds.csv\', index=False)\n    (out / \'addone_fits.json\').write_text(json.dumps(fits, indent=2))\n    (out / \'addone_manifest.json\').write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2))\n    return summary, by_fold, manifest, predictions\n')

    _ = (RA_OUT/'default_public_protocol.md').write_text('# Reverse add-one audit: public S6E10 predictions\n\nWritten before running these reverse comparisons, 29 October 2026. This is an exploratory follow-up to v21: the same historical labels and public prediction files have already been inspected. TabPFN35 is the reference because it led the standalone scores in that example. Neither this choice nor the follow-up is independent confirmation.\n\n## Fixed question\n\nDoes adding each of XGBoost, RealMLP, TabICL2 and TabFM improve a logistic combiner using only TabPFN35? Run all four candidates with seeds 42 and 20261029: eight planned comparisons, no selection by leaderboard or observed improvement. Use all 699635 labelled rows, sorted by ID, and stratified fivefold combiner splits. Use exactly the same train/validation indices for every candidate at a given seed.\n\nReuse the v21 probability-to-logit transform (clip 1e-6), L2 logistic regression C=1, intercept, no scaling, lbfgs tol=1e-7, max_iter=2000, one CPU thread. Fit both reference and expanded combiners on training rows only. No early stopping or tuning. Score each row exactly once for each partition. Reference means a cross-fitted one-column logistic combiner, not the unchanged raw TabPFN35 vector: different fold intercepts/slopes can change pooled ordering. Report raw reference AUC separately and verify all reference slopes are positive; any failure blocks interpretation until diagnosed.\n\n## Evidence and scope\n\nPublish all eight pooled AUC differences and all forty fold differences. Approximate paired DeLong intervals use Bonferroni for eight comparisons at nominal 95% familywise level; these conditional intervals omit cross-fitting dependence, upstream training and repeated historical model selection, so coverage is not guaranteed. Seeds reuse rows and are not independent replications. No private-board, end-to-end nested-validation or final-slot claims. Do not rank candidates into an automatic recommendation or use a significance cutoff to pick a winner.\n\nMeasure elapsed audit time as a receipt for processing cached OOF arrays. It includes refitting, scoring, checks and export; upstream model training/inference and reading original arrays are excluded. It is not a comparison of training costs or AUC per GPU-hour. Use only public input arrays and competition labels, preserving the existing input hashes from stage 1. Publish source, settings, split IDs, coefficients, hashes and results; keep local prediction arrays for independent verification.\n\n## Release gate\n\nIndependent rank-sum AUC verification, exact row coverage, disjoint train/validation checks, converged fits, equal reference predictions across candidates, and all eight comparisons completed. Verify public default source parity before edits. Review entire updated document for factual accuracy, reader value, private edge and Humanizer, then execute the full notebook, publish to the existing slug and inspect the rendered public default. No submission or final-slot changes.\n')
    _ = (RA_OUT/'default_public_freeze.json').write_text('{\n  "utc": "2026-10-29T12:07:19.229941+00:00",\n  "inputs": {\n    "train.csv": "2313b65c74e6994f01c2628aae82d2f97aa6f74a81950172ff83864837c98b36",\n    "oof_xgboost.npy": "be0862fe5eb2872fda139fb5e75435d7119b693f2a2bfc0d2403e794e2b429a1",\n    "oof_realmlp.npy": "d2ef10c8d4e246315fbbb91c57651efa98bf03cf7cb7e7bfd5d4ac51428a381b",\n    "oof_tabicl2.npy": "9b27d7d1769a4bd7afab9ba68112cef013339b54fe0f4ae0ce3985a9849c9a1f",\n    "oof_tabfm.npy": "f18a495a22acf272a468135b22aed2245f7cc609e3720f766662e15b2979feed",\n    "oof_tabpfn35.npy": "f75c9d1de9ea23c310a36c175e4552916928f16b3530ed5f51b8c783c3e75e95"\n  },\n  "sources": {\n    "PROTOCOL.md": "75b97ef7018e7eb34fec3973fd31a7ae1c561148ca49fd410de5d144857275bb",\n    "addone_audit.py": "a7a48873a3a794a1b5bd5f1050ae705cf5758c8f4844a57cbde2a54018ca78d5",\n    "reverse_audit.py": "6de4fc2f79b975a45c17733e108711d5160234a91e7d1a23d8029161fd322d47",\n    "run_public.py": "6a1041ba2c0002799cfe35489022ee634fef6a2c6da539824c7bf6ff2ece5025"\n  },\n  "reference": "TabPFN35",\n  "candidates": [\n    "XGBoost",\n    "RealMLP",\n    "TabICL2",\n    "TabFM"\n  ],\n  "seeds": [\n    42,\n    20261029\n  ],\n  "C": 1\n}')

import base64
import html
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from io import BytesIO
from IPython.display import HTML, Markdown, display

# Frozen values from the completed pilot receipt. This cell renders the recorded
# comparison; it does not refit the candidate or the upstream public models.
pilot = {
    "influence_corr": 0.8876919277101588,
    "diversity_cutoff": 0.99,
    "standalone_delta": -0.0027406423239769717,
    "standalone_ci": (-0.0034580339365671725, -0.002023250711386771),
    "stack_delta": -1.2622855045663073e-06,
    "stack_ci": (-4.511358923913165e-06, 1.98678791478055e-06),
    "useful_effect_floor": 2e-5,
    "raw_null_auc": 0.5032234744415783,
    "null_min": 0.497,
    "null_max": 0.503,
}

standalone_delta = pilot["standalone_delta"]
standalone_ci = pilot["standalone_ci"]
stack_delta = pilot["stack_delta"]
stack_ci = pilot["stack_ci"]
useful_effect_floor = pilot["useful_effect_floor"]

pilot_text = f"""An 18 October stagewise neural pilot passed the pre-set error-diversity screen: its per-row AUC influence values had a correlation of {pilot["influence_corr"]:.3f} with those of the strongest GBDT, below the {pilot["diversity_cutoff"]:.2f} cutoff. This was a screening diagnostic, not an acceptance criterion by itself. Its standalone AUC was {abs(standalone_delta):.5f} lower than the GBDT.

Adding it as a feature to the 247-column public OOF pool and refitting the logistic combiner on the same calibration rows changed held-out AUC by {stack_delta:+.7f}. The Bonferroni-adjusted 95% interval for four comparisons ran from {stack_ci[0]:+.7f} to {stack_ci[1]:+.7f} and crossed zero. The point estimate also fell short of the {useful_effect_floor:+.5f} useful-effect floor.

In the raw-input arm, the shuffled-label pipeline scored {pilot["raw_null_auc"]:.5f}, just above the allowed range of {pilot["null_min"]:.3f} to {pilot["null_max"]:.3f}. The pilot failed qualification, so we made no submission or slot change.

For a new model family, keep error diversity, standalone quality, improvement over your prespecified reference recipe, and the shuffled-target control separate.

The cohort was reused during model search, so this result is exploratory. The stack comparison uses supplied public OOF predictions, and its interval excludes variation from upstream refitting and model search. It does not estimate private-board performance."""
display(Markdown(pilot_text))

fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(8.1, 2.9), layout="constrained")
ax = axes[0]
ax.axvline(0, color="#555", lw=1)
ax.errorbar([standalone_delta * 1e3], [0],
            xerr=[[ (standalone_delta - standalone_ci[0]) * 1e3],
                  [ (standalone_ci[1] - standalone_delta) * 1e3]],
            fmt="o", color="#176b9a", ecolor="#176b9a", capsize=4, lw=2, ms=7)
ax.set_yticks([])
ax.set_xlim(-4.3, 1.0)
ax.set_ylim(-.65, .65)
ax.set_title("Standalone vs GBDT", fontsize=18, pad=8)
ax.set_xlabel("ΔAUC (× 10⁻³)", fontsize=16)
ax.grid(axis="x", alpha=.22)

ax = axes[1]
ax.axvline(0, color="#555", lw=1)
ax.axvline(useful_effect_floor * 1e6, color="#c65d00", lw=1.5, ls="--")
ax.errorbar([stack_delta * 1e6], [0],
            xerr=[[ (stack_delta - stack_ci[0]) * 1e6],
                  [ (stack_ci[1] - stack_delta) * 1e6]],
            fmt="o", color="#176b9a", ecolor="#176b9a", capsize=4, lw=2, ms=7)
ax.set_yticks([])
ax.set_xlim(-6, 25)
ax.set_ylim(-.65, .65)
ax.set_title("Incremental stack gain", fontsize=18, pad=8)
ax.set_xlabel("ΔAUC (× 10⁻⁶)", fontsize=16)
ax.grid(axis="x", alpha=.22)
ax.text(19, .56, "+20 floor", transform=ax.transData,
        ha="right", va="top", fontsize=14, color="#a34c00")

for ax in axes:
    ax.tick_params(axis="x", labelsize=14)

image_buffer = BytesIO()
fig.savefig(image_buffer, format="png", dpi=100)
alt_text = "GrowNet pilot AUC estimates and adjusted confidence intervals. Standalone score is below the strongest GBDT; the refit-combiner stack gain is near zero and below the useful-effect floor."
image_b64 = base64.b64encode(image_buffer.getvalue()).decode("ascii")
display(HTML(f'<img alt="{html.escape(alt_text, quote=True)}" src="data:image/png;base64,{image_b64}" style="max-width:100%;height:auto;" />'))
plt.close(fig)
